title: Editor meters and AutoUi readouts repaint only what changed

needles: AutoUi value rows repaint their own box when a value changes

installed_sdk.rationale: No SDK type or call is added for musicians or plug-in authors to use; Meter overrides an existing View hook so its own ballistics keep owning its invalidation, and AutoUi's value row keeps its text and position.

offline_timeline_cli.rationale: No offline Timeline command is added or altered; the change is when an editor repaints.

offline_timeline_mcp.rationale: No MCP operation is added, removed or changed.

live_product_control.rationale: No product control, grant or policy projection is created; parameter values, automation and gestures are unchanged.

design_time_agent_manifest.rationale: No design-time authoring capability is added or altered.
